verdict.rationale: Mem0 offers webhooks that fire HTTP POSTs on memory events (create/update/delete/categorize), which is the closest thing to event-triggered automation, but there is no rule-definition language or built-in action engine — webhooks only notify an external URL, leaving the actual 'action' logic to be built elsewhere. Missing for 10: a native rules/conditions engine, support for defining custom trigger-action pairs, and any evidence of automated in-product actions beyond notification.
